theorem_title: The alternating expansion recurrence cannot hold forever
natural_language_statement:
For every sequence $x:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$,

$$
\neg\bigl(\forall i\in\mathbb N,\ 8x_{i+1}=9x_i+5\bigr).
$$

Arbitrarily long finite blocks can coexist with the impossibility of one infinite fixed-block orbit.
formal_statement:
theorem BlindCollatz.RepetitionBound.no_infinite_alternating_blocks (x : Nat → Nat) :
    ¬ (∀ i, 8 * x (i + 1) = 9 * x i + 5) := by sorry
